items.title: Define focused/full validation layering without weakening full validation
items.context: Use docs/requirements/decisions/lattice-workflow-efficiency-baseline.md item validateCostAndTimeoutRisk. Add a narrow config/CLI behavior so development can run focused checks while final validation remains full.

happy.desc: A focused validate profile runs a configured subset and reports focused mode clearly.

edge.desc: The default validate path still runs the full configured command set unless focused is explicitly requested.

adversarial.desc: Focused validation cannot be mistaken for final full validation or DONE-required proof.

items.title: Raise validate timeout margin through code and config evidence
items.context: Update timeout defaults only where they protect against false timeout classification; keep per-command timeout attribution and process-group kill behavior.

happy.desc: Default validate command timeout is high enough for the normal full validate envelope and still bounded.

edge.desc: Explicit per-command timeoutMs still overrides the default.

adversarial.desc: The timeout change does not allow unbounded validation or mask hung commands.

items.title: Write post-fix comparison artifact for baseline item 1
items.context: Create a derived result artifact under experiments/baselines/ referencing lattice-workflow-efficiency-baseline-v1; do not rewrite the immutable baseline.

happy.desc: A result artifact references baselineId and this story id.

edge.desc: The immutable baseline file remains unchanged.

adversarial.desc: The result artifact does not claim reduced wall-clock time as proof by itself.
